name: detector_benchmark_v4_ofs
purpose: Add the published OFS-k motion-copy detector (Chen et al., 2024, arXiv 2410.21669) to the v4 detector benchmark, scored on the identical clips.
base_configuration: experiments/detector_benchmark_v4.json (same splits, seeds, gallery, queries, transformations, calibration rule, and copy gate)
detector: RAFT-small optical flow for every consecutive frame pair; per-cell cosine similarity between time-aligned flows; OFS-k is the maximum over k-frame windows of the mean similarity; k in {3, 5, 10}, k = 3 primary as in the paper
adaptations: Flow computed at 128 px from the 224 px clips and average-pooled to a 16 x 16 grid before per-cell cosine (compute adaptation; the paper uses full-resolution pixels).
Natural-motion filtering omitted: the synthetic scenes contain no camera panning or static frames.
registered_expectation: OFS-k is appearance-invariant in principle, so it should recover more same-trajectory rerenders than SSCD under appearance change, but sparse disk motion on a static background may limit separation and mirroring and time shifts break time-aligned flow matching.
